All Classes and Interfaces

Classes
Class
Description
AccessTokenRoleReader
Reads roles from the access token, e.g. the realm roles of keycloak at realm_access.roles.
AdminGroupSynchronizer
Synchronizes the global administrator permission ("*") of a user with the configured admin group on every login.
AfterLogoutRedirectToIdp
Performs an RP-initiated logout at the identity provider, if the configuration flag "ssoLogout" is set.
AuthenticationInfoBuilder
Everything which happens during a login, in one place.
AuthorizationRequest
A pending authorization request: the state which is handed to the identity provider, the pkce verifier and the nonce belonging to it and the url the user should be redirected to after a successful login.
ConfigurationDto
Transport format of the configuration.
ConfigurationMapper
Maps between the persisted configuration and the dto of the REST api.
ConfigurationModule
Guice module of the plugin.
ConfigurationResource
REST endpoint of the plugin configuration, used by the administration ui.
Constants
Constants which are shared between backend classes.
DiscoveryClient
Fetches the OIDC discovery document (.well-known/openid-configuration) of the identity provider and extracts the endpoints from it.
EndpointResolver
Resolves the identity provider endpoints.
Endpoints
The resolved endpoints of the identity provider, either taken from the manual configuration or from the OIDC discovery document.
ForceOAuth2LoginFilter
Forces unauthenticated browser requests to the identity provider, if the configuration flag "forceLogin" is set.
GroupStore
Stores the group names of the last login per user.
GroupSynchronizer
Synchronizes the groups of the group claim with the scm group database on every login: groups which do not exist yet are created with the user as member the user is added as member to existing groups from the claim the user is removed from groups which were synchronized on a previous login, but are no longer part of the claim groups are never deleted, even if they become empty Only groups which were previously synchronized for this user are touched on removal, so manually maintained memberships in other groups are preserved.
IdTokenStore
Keeps the id token of the last login per user in memory.
IndexConfigurationEnricher
Adds the links of the plugin to the index resource (/api/v2/).
JwksClient
Fetches the json web key set of the identity provider (rfc 7517) and turns it into public keys.
JwksProvider
Caches the json web key set of the identity provider and resolves the key of a signature.
LoginHandler
Turns a successful callback into a browser session.
OAuth2AuthenticationResource
The two http endpoints of the authorization code flow.
OAuth2Configuration
The complete configuration of the plugin, persisted as config/oauth2.xml by OAuth2Context and edited through the administration ui.
OAuth2Context
Access to the persisted OAuth2Configuration.
OAuth2ExternalAuthenticationAvailableNotifier
Tells the core that an external authentication is available.
OAuth2GroupResolver
Tells SCM-Manager which groups a user belongs to.
OAuth2Realm
Shiro realm for the authorization code flow.
OAuth2RestClient
Client for the OAuth2/OIDC endpoints of the identity provider.
OAuth2Token
Shiro authentication token which carries the authorization code received from the identity provider and the redirect uri which was used to obtain it.
StateStore
Holds the pending authorization requests.
TokenResponse
Relevant parts of the response of the token endpoint.
TokenVerifier
Verifies the tokens of the identity provider: signature first, then the claims.
UserInfoMapper
Maps the claims of an OIDC userinfo response to an SCM-Manager user and its group memberships.
UserMigration
Takes over users which already exist in SCM-Manager, e.g. when an instance is switched from ldap authentication to oauth2 and the identity provider delivers the same user names.
